timeSemantics.conclusion: Time column behaves as completion/log-recording time, not request start.
timeSemantics.basis: Seven successful requests match exact input/output token usage and stream flag, and provider logged time is within one second of local completion.
timeSemantics.estimatedStartCaveat: Provider elapsed is reported in whole seconds; subtraction is approximate. First work request start is ledger admission, not exact dispatch.

diagnosticBatchAccounting.feeBasis: Source CSV consumption entries only; not a balance reconciliation or refund determination.

boundaries.clientGone: Reported by user from dashboard; absent from this CSV, whose detail cells are empty.
boundaries.firstTokenLatency: Not exported. CSV elapsed must not be called time to first token.
boundaries.requestAttribution: Failed rows strongly correlated from timing and request shape, not joined on a locally captured provider ID.
boundaries.delayCause: Provider consumption records show the correlated requests were processed and accounted after client cancellation. Queueing, model latency and upstream forwarding delay cannot be separated by this export.
boundaries.otherAgents: Five other CSV rows are not attributed to this diagnostic sequence; no evidence that shared-key concurrency caused the delays.
boundaries.productAcceptance: Client timeout results remain failures. No tools, worker concurrency or full work acceptance added.
